agent.description: Agent-facing runtime capabilities controlled by this toolset file.

allow_package_discovery.description: Allow the agent to search and inspect available packages. Defaults to true when omitted.

unsafe.description: Agent capabilities that are disabled by default because they mutate the active toolset.

allow_toolset_management.description: Allow the agent to install, uninstall, authenticate, or otherwise change the active toolset. Defaults to false when omitted.
